title: On Finiteness of Homological Isoperimetric Functions on Top Dimensions
summary: We address a question from \cite{BKV25} regarding the finiteness of the homological $R$-isoperimetric function. Let $R$ be a subfield of the complex numbers $\mathbb{C}$ with the absolute value norm. We prove that for any group $G$ that admits a finite $(n+1)$-dimensional model for $K(G,1)$, the homological $n$-isoperimetric function of $G$ over $R$ is either linear or takes infinite values.
